subject: Status: curriculum results + tooling risks
body:
Hi both,

Status: the generation pipeline is producing compositional web environments end to end — we're on the legacy MiniWoB branch pinned at the release commit, with the 2to3-converted Python bindings, plus the bootstrap-based page templates. Quentin's difficulty scheduler ramps the number of composed primitives per page.

First real result: curriculum-trained agents hit 58% zero-shot success on held-out compositional tasks vs 37% for agents trained on the fixed task set — a +21-point generalization gap in our favor, in line with the original result.

Risks: (1) the legacy MiniWoB dependency is fragile — the 2to3 conversion breaks on two wrappers whenever we bump Python, so Halima pinned the toolchain; (2) rater UI v0 slipped a week (replay backend), now targeting 7/3 — still compatible with the July evals.

Yara
